entries.rationale: GUID-preserving Unity component facade; all ledger authority and transitions live in DungeonStory.Operation and all scene/economy/event work lives in OperatingDaySettlementApplicationAdapter.

Reviewed strict save bundle: mutable collections are DTO payloads, while the readonly runtime service only performs canonical validation and detached prepare/publish staging; no independent settlement writer exists.
Reviewed immutable report/value contracts plus transient Unity event envelopes and publisher; the source contains no persistent mutable settlement authority or save writer.

Reviewed Unity application adapter: persistent modes, sessions, advertising, version transitions, completion idempotence, and restore reconstruction live in DungeonStory.ServiceRooms; this source only resolves scene hubs/characters, maintains removable Unity subscriptions, queries research/power, and executes one aggregate-issued money command.

GUID-preserving fieldless compatibility facade; deterministic run-flow transitions live in DungeonStory.Content and all invasion, pacing, owner, alert, and restore projection work lives in DungeonRunFlowApplicationAdapter.
